text:
support_jen: FYI — Acme reports promo credits vanished after a partial refund. Dashboard shows credits back, invoice still charged. ticket=INC-89234, invoice=inv_0A12B. Can someone triage? :eyes:

maya_billing: Can you paste the org id and approx times? Also does the customer see token usage on dashboard that matches invoice?

support_jen: org_acme_89234. Customer says refund was issued at 2024-08-03T15:42Z. They ran ~3 calls that day, token counts small (~1200 tokens). Screenshot: "Credits: 0 / Promo-SEP23 (expired 2024-09-01)" but invoices show charge for those tokens.

samir_backend: quick thought — refund flow creates ledger rows `refund_hold` then `refund_release`. Metering snapshots run on schedule; possible race where snapshot runs after hold but before release. Can you share sample request ids or request_ts?

support_jen: Provided request ids in ticket: req_aa11, req_bb22, req_cc33. Here's the customer's repro note: they triggered a plan change + refund while usage was in-flight.

billing-bot: Ledger events for org_acme_89234 around 1994567000..1994568000:
```
1994567556: promo_grant id=grant_7a, amount=50
1994567601: invoice_charge id=inv_0A12B, tokens=1200, cost=0.12
1994567630: refund_hold id=ref_41
1994567668: metering_snapshot id=ms_99 (applied charges)
1994567700: refund_release id=ref_41_release amount=0.12
```

lucas_engineer: That ordering would definitely cause a discrepancy: snapshot applied charges before refund_release, so invoice shows full charge even though refund later released credits. We need to ensure refund_release is reflected in the same snapshot window or retroactively adjust invoice bookkeeping.

samir_backend: Repro steps I used locally to mirror:
```
# create promo grant
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_acme_89234/credits -d '{"grant_id":"grant_7a","units":50}'
# simulate usage
for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $USER" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":400}'; done
# trigger refund job
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING" https://billing.internal/ refunds -d '{"invoice":"inv_0A12B","type":"partial","amount":0.12}'
```

maya_billing: I ran a query against ledger to find final balances: (simplified)
```
SELECT event_type, amount, created_at FROM ledger WHERE org_id='org_acme_89234' ORDER BY created_at;
-- shows refund_release after metering_snapshot
```

support_jen: Customer asking for timeline + whether we can auto-apply credits to reconcile the invoice. They want either an invoice credit or manual top-up while we investigate.

lucas_engineer: Short-term: we can issue a manual credit (grant_7a-recon) and mark it with metadata referencing inv_0A12B so billing support can apply. Long-term: change snapshot to be idempotent and include pending refund_release events or process refund_release synchronously for partial refunds.

samir_backend: I've opened an internal PR to make refund_release update a `snapshot_epoch` before metering runs and to add a compensating job that fixes invoices when release arrives after snapshot: https://git.internal/redwood/billing/pull/5423 (WIP).

maya_billing: For this org I applied an emergency credit of $0.12 (grant id grant_7a-recon) and posted an adjustment note on invoice inv_0A12B. Customer notified. Will monitor for similar hits.

support_jen: I messaged Acme: "We've applied a temporary credit and are adding a permanent fix; will follow up with postmortem." They replied: "Thanks! Please let us know when it's fixed — we hit this while consolidating refunds across seats." :thumbsup:

acme_billing_contact: Thanks for the quick help, appreciate the manual credit. Please confirm once root cause is deployed.

samir_backend: Putting a small note — edge case: plan changes that trigger refunds during active streaming/generation result in `metering_snapshot` seeing the hold but not release. Adding a 1s jitter and forcing release-before-snapshot reduces repro but PR is the real fix.

support_jen: Closing loop: emergency credit applied, PR opened, will create a short postmortem and notify accounts flagged in last 30d.

billing-bot: Incident record created: INC-89234 | type=billing_discrepancy | severity=low | assigned=billing-team

support_jen: Thanks everyone — marking resolved for now, will reopen if customer sees another discrepancy. :white_check_mark:
